dataset: Deoxyfluorination of 37 alcohols under 20 sulfonyl fluoride and base combinations

measurements.title: Deoxyfluorination with Sulfonyl Fluorides: Navigating Reaction Space with Machine Learning
measurements.journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society

repository_paper.title: Identifying general reaction conditions by bandit optimization

license: MIT license of the source repository at the pinned commit (Copyright (c) 2012-2023 Jason Y. Wang and others); full text in data/LICENSE-bandit-optimization.txt. Later versions of the repository (from March 2025) use GPL-3.0; the shipped table comes from the MIT-licensed commit.
selection: all 740 rows (37 alcohols, 20 conditions); only the alcohol ID, alcohol SMILES, sulfonyl fluoride, base, and yield columns are kept
row_order: alcohols s1 to s37 by number; within each alcohol, sulfonyl fluoride in the order 3-Cl, PyFluor, 3-CF3, 3-NO2, PBSF, then base in the order DBU, MTBD, BTMG, BTPP
yield: 19F NMR yield of the alkyl fluoride product, percent, as published (integers from 0 to 106)
